_doc: What the hourly workflows run. Change stage/n to move from calibration to the main series; results go to branch runs-<lane>/<stage>/. Budgets are requests per hour per lane; keep their sum <= 180 (Kilo free: 200/h). Each run dispatches the next one while work remains and progress was made (GitHub cron alone fired ~2x in 9 h). Harness rows of an older harness_version are re-run; base rows are kept. Ablations on SB: facts = base + input facts (1 call); retry = base + retry on crash only; noverify = harness without the LLM judge.
